name: Positioning statement writer
why: Writes one clear positioning line from buyer evidence and rivals, with the proof it needs; a quick start for the product-positioning-and-message-sheet skill.

name: Write your customers' job and name its real rivals
why: Finds the job buyers hire the product for and the real alternatives, the first step of Dunford-style positioning.

name: Map your rivals and write a message they cannot answer
why: A full run from rival map to a message rivals cannot easily copy, matching the rival-claim-map prompt.

name: One-line position writer
why: Finds the one idea to own and how far to stretch it, useful when the team wants to say five things.

name: Rival gap message writer
why: Writes messages from proven strengths against a rival's public weak spots, with the evidence and the rival's likely reply.

name: Claim evidence checker
why: Lists stated and implied claims and checks each against the proof held, the core of the claims file.

name: Ad claim proof gap finder
why: Finds claims that the proof does not back and suggests a fix for each, before a page or ad goes live.

name: Comparison page set planner
why: Plans best-of, alternatives and vs pages for each rival; every page it plans still goes through the claims check and a fresh yes.

name: Monthly competitor watcher
why: Spots what rivals changed each month, feeding the quarterly positioning and rival review.

name: Three-tier price ladder drafter
why: Drafts a plain, middle and top tier with who each is for, a starting point for the pricing-page-and-packaging-review skill.

name: Pre-sell to three buyers, then launch in thirty days
why: A demand-first launch path for small teams, in the spirit of the demand-test-design prompt.

name: Go or no-go launch checker
why: Checks a launch plan for common faults and readiness before money is spent.

name: Launch a smaller product on the date you set
why: A launch plan sized to a small team and a fixed date, matching the launch-sizing step.

name: SaaS launch decision agent
why: Turns launch results into a dated decision log of what to test, revise or keep, for the day-7 and day-14 reviews.

name: USP claim checker
why: Scores a selling claim on offer, rivals and pull before spend, a quick screen alongside the message sheet.
